text.en:
The participation of government personnel in international
training activities, seminars and conferences pertaining to or having to do with
transnational crime shall have the proper indorsement by the PCTC.

The Secretary of the Interior and Local Government,
the concurrent Chairman of the National Police Commission, shall issue detailed
guidelines to implement this Order.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this ~
the year of our Lord,
Nineteen Hundred and Ninety Nine.
